title: Skin Photocarcinogenesis by Sunbed in SKH-1 Mice
author: Francisco Jose Gomez-Garcia
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bc45iyy6

steps.title: Perform UV Irradiation
steps.instruction: Expose SKH-1 mice to UV radiation using a Philips lamp (Type HB 554/01/A) with 8 Philips Performance S 100W tubes (emission spectrum 220-425 nm, peak 364 nm, 98.6% UVA and 1.4% UVB).

substeps.instruction: Place animals in PVC cages with individual separators and a metallic lattice ceiling.
Position the light source 20 cm above the skin.
Irradiate the mice for 60 minutes per session, three times a week, for a total of 80 sessions.
Ensure each session delivers 21.1 J/cm2, totaling 1688 J/cm2 by the end of the experiment.

steps.title: Conduct Macroscopic Skin Study
steps.instruction: Perform a detailed macroscopic study of the dorsal skin after each irradiation session.

substeps.instruction: Take digital photographs on millimeter paper to measure lesional areas at the end of the 80 sessions.
Use Leica Qwin image processing and analysis software to obtain a binary mask and measure lesional areas individually.

steps.title: Perform Necropsy and Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Sacrifice animals and prepare skin and viscera samples for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Perform necropsy on the dorsal skin and viscera.
Stain samples with haematoxylin and eosin.

steps.title: Analyze Samples via Light Microscopy
steps.instruction: Examine samples under a Leica DM 6000B light microscope to identify normal skin, actinic keratoses, dysplasia, carcinoma in situ, and invasive carcinoma.

steps.title: Perform Immunohistochemical Study
steps.instruction: Conduct immunohistochemical analysis of tumors using the streptavidin-biotin method.

substeps.instruction: Incubate sections overnight at 4°C with antibodies at a 1:200 dilution for PCNA (PC-10; Dako Corporation, Glostrup, Denmark), p53, anti-metaloproteinase-9 (MMP-9), and anti-metallopeptidase inhibitor 1 (TIMP-1) (Dako, S.A, Barcelona, Spain).
Prepare negative controls by treating with all reagents except the primary antibody.

steps.title: Quantify PCNA Expression
steps.instruction: Quantify PCNA expression using digitalized specimens and image analysis software.

substeps.instruction: Obtain high resolution images using a Leica SCN400F microscopy scanning system.
Trace three 100 μm2 areas on each image from the tumor invasion front (or epidermis basal layer if no carcinoma is present) using the Slidepath Digital Image Hub analysis module.
Use Nuclear Algorythm 3.0 to count positive nuclei and total cells based on a defined color pattern.
Express quantification as the mean percentage of PCNA positive cells relative to total cell number.

steps.title: Perform Semi-Quantitative Immunohistochemical Analysis
steps.instruction: Calculate scores for TIMP and MMP-9 based on stroma staining.

substeps.instruction: Determine the percentage of stained stroma surface: grade 0 (none), grade 1 (<10%), grade 2 (10-50%), and grade 3 (51-100%).
Determine the graded intensity of stained stroma (grade 0-3).
Multiply the surface percentage grade by the intensity grade to obtain the final score.
